description: Where each module in lean4/ came from, its score under the_symbol_game SCORING.md v2.0.0 at the source commit, and why the source keeps a working copy. Records only; it grants nothing.
graded_commit_note: None of the ten files changed between the graded commit and the source commit.
grading: Re-homing review of 2026-10-27: one reviewer and one adversary pass per file. The report is held outside this repository.
maintainer_decisions: 2026-10-27: the Symbol Game kernel goes to a new top-level lean4/ in this repository.

2026-10-27: only files at L2D or better move; the_symbol_game keeps working copies of files its own code still imports. Pre-Genesis, Genesis, S(n) and MSS-N go to theory_of_finite_quantum_mechanics; the S(n)-labelled kernel files go here by the maintainer's ruling of the same day.

not_moved.reason: MSS-N, not Symbol Game: namespace MSSN.Demo3Protocol, and theory_of_finite_quantum_mechanics imported it on 2026-10-23 as lean4/Imported/LegacyTopLevel/Demo3ProtocolInvariants.lean with 'Reason: MSS-N'. MSS-N's home is that repository, which already holds the code. The adversary pass also scores it G1=E: hash_chain_step_injective is (A -> B) -> A -> B under a name that claims injectivity. papers/completion_receipt.json still pins lean4/Demo3ProtocolInvariants.lean; that receipt was made in a the_symbol_game checkout.
Its only import, Expressivity, is L1D, below the L2D rule.
